meta.source: InternFeel logo (2024 wordmark and 2017 mark) and the theme's design tokens in wp-content/themes/internfeel/style.css; type, dark theme and status colours added for the 2026 relaunch

tokens.name: if-canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind sections and lists.

tokens.name: if-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, header, form fields, dialogs: anything that sits on if-canvas.

tokens.name: if-surface-tint
tokens.usage: Teal-tinted panels: the key-facts box, the hero band, selected filter chips, the Verified badge background.

tokens.name: if-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card and input borders, dividers.

tokens.name: if-line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders and unselected chip outlines (3:1 on if-surface and if-canvas in both themes).

tokens.name: if-ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on if-canvas, if-surface and if-surface-tint.

tokens.name: if-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, captions on if-canvas, if-surface and if-surface-tint.

tokens.name: if-charcoal
tokens.usage: The logo's charcoal. Footer background and dark brand blocks.

tokens.name: if-on-charcoal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on if-charcoal (footer).

tokens.name: if-teal
tokens.usage: The logo's teal. Decoration, large display text (24px+), borders, illustration and the badge symbol. Not for body text or small links: 3.4:1 on white.

tokens.name: if-teal-700
tokens.usage: Links, primary button fill, selected states, the Verified badge text. 5.3:1 on if-surface (light); 10:1 on if-surface (dark).

tokens.name: if-teal-800
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of if-teal-700; text on if-surface-tint.

tokens.name: if-on-teal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an if-teal-700 fill (primary button label).

tokens.name: if-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: if-warning
tokens.usage: In review and Pending states; text on if-warning-soft or the surfaces.

tokens.name: if-warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind if-warning text.

tokens.name: if-danger
tokens.usage: Errors, Rejected and Removed states, destructive actions; text on if-danger-soft or the surfaces.

tokens.name: if-danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind if-danger text: form errors, rejection notes.

tokens.name: if-ad-ground
tokens.usage: Background of reserved ad slots, so an empty slot reads as a placeholder, not a broken card.

families.body: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Atkinson Hyperlegible", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Real internship experiences from students who've been there
styles.usage: Home hero headline only. One per page.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Page titles: the experience title (the page H1), hub and listicle titles. 28px on phones.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section headings and listicle row titles.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card titles, dashboard panel titles, form step titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: I was selected for the SPARK program, a summer research internship at IIT Roorkee.
styles.usage: The story on an experience page: long reading, max 68 characters a line.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Share your experience and help juniors choose better internships.
styles.usage: Default text: forms, dashboard, cards' supporting line.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text, key-fact values, button labels.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata: dates, view counts, helper text, credit lines.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels: key-fact names, the IF question marker, ad labels, eyebrow over a section.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Certificate numbers, invite codes, counts in tables.

tokens.name: if-space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: if-space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, gaps inside a card's meta row.

tokens.name: if-space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and between stacked form controls.

tokens.name: if-space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones, the page side gutter, default gap.

tokens.name: if-space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gap between cards.

tokens.name: if-space-8
tokens.usage: Space between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: if-space-12
tokens.usage: Space between major page bands (hero, listicles, how it works).

tokens.name: if-radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, status pills' inner marks, ad label tag.

tokens.name: if-radius
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, the key-facts box, dialogs.

tokens.name: if-radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, filter chips, status pills, the search field.

tokens.name: if-shadow-raise
tokens.usage: Hovered experience card and open menus only. Resting cards use a border, not a shadow.

tokens.name: if-content
tokens.usage: Maximum content width (1152px).

tokens.name: if-reading
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the story column (about 68 characters at body-lg).

tokens.name: if-header-h
tokens.usage: Header height at the top of the page.

tokens.name: if-header-h-compact
tokens.usage: Header height once the page has scrolled.
